title: The Landfall of Cape Reckoning
author: Astrid Eriksen
blurb: Oscar Coldharbour, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
